tagline: Controls, tutorial lessons, quests, and source-backed reference pages for OSRS Clone.
footerNote: Reviewed gameplay guidance and reference data for the game revision linked below.
intro: Start with How to play for controls, Tutorial Island, combat, quests, settings, and local saves. Open a journey when you want a practical resource or equipment goal.
Item, skill, world, and enemy pages use the game export. The version note explains the reviewed runtime revision and coverage.

homeSections.title: Tutorial Island
homeSections.body: New characters learn gathering, food, smithing, melee, ranged, magic, runes, crafting, and the shared bank before Main Overworld.

homeSections.title: Six runtime quests
homeSections.body: Quest objectives and rewards now cover Tanner Rusk, Thrain Deepforge, the Advanced Fletcher and Woodsman, the Fishing Teacher, and Elira Gemhand.

homeSections.title: Current reference data
homeSections.body: The current export includes cooked and burnt animal meat, borrowed jewelry, clay moulds, combat item requirements, and ten enemy definitions.
